meta.via: county and city websites and the Virginia OEMS licensed-agency list (local sources)

services.name: Fairfax County Fire and Rescue Department
services.area: Fairfax County excl. independent cities of Fairfax and Falls Church
services.evidence: Emergency Medical Service (EMS) transport billing began on April 1, 2005 in Fairfax County. ... FCFRD contracts with an outside company, Digitech Computer LLC , to handle EMS transport billing, coding, and processing.

51059.page_note: Fairfax County Fire and Rescue holds the only ground-ambulance licence in the county. This covers the county only; independent cities such as Fairfax city are listed separately, and Falls Church, Fort Belvoir and Dulles Airport were not separately checked.
51059.second_source: OEMS roster FAIRFAX COUNTY FIRE & RESCUE ALS/BLS

services.name: City of Fairfax Fire Department
services.evidence: The City of Fairfax, as well as the majority of our surrounding jurisdictions, charge medical insurance carriers for ambulance transport services. ... Cost recovery from EMS billing is directed back to the fire department for the purchase of ambulances and other emergency equipment.

51600.page_note: The City of Fairfax runs its own fire department, separate from Fairfax County.

services.name: Arlington County Fire Department
services.evidence: The Arlington County Fire Department's highly skilled personnel provide Emergency Medical Services (EMS), including ambulance transportation, over 15,000 times per year.

51013.page_note: Arlington County Fire Department is the only licensed ground-ambulance agency in Arlington.

services.name: Norfolk Fire-Rescue
services.evidence: Norfolk Fire-Rescue ( NFR ) is responsible for providing all emergency medical service within the City of Norfolk. This is accomplished with a medic (ambulance) fleet that consists of 14 advanced life support licensed units that are in service 24/7.

51710.page_note: Norfolk Fire-Rescue provides ALS; the other licences in Norfolk are a children's hospital neonatal service and air ambulance.

services.name: Alexandria Fire Department
services.evidence: What is the charge for being transported to the hospital by a medic unit? ... The City of Alexandria Fire Department’s ambulance billing is handled by a third-party company EMS/MC Management Consultants

51510.page_note: Alexandria Fire Department provides ALS and BLS. RIDE24 is a commercial licence and is not shown as a 911 provider.

services.name: Newport News Fire Department
services.evidence: The ambulance transport fees ("the Fees") established by City code Section 16-60 shall be charged to every patient transported by the Newport News Fire Department in an emergency medical services vehicle without regard to that patient's ability to pay.

51700.page_note: Newport News Fire Department provides ALS; Newport News Shipbuilding's fire department is an industrial licence.

services.name: Chesapeake Fire Department
services.evidence: From our 15 fire stations, we provide fire protection, rescue, and emergency medical services for the 353 square miles of urban, suburban, and rural areas within our city limits.

51550.page_note: Chesapeake Fire Department is licensed for ALS ground ambulance, but its page says EMS rather than transport. Not yet confirmed from a city page: that it transports, or the role of the commercial licensees Fast Track EMS and LifeWay.

services.name: Hampton Division of Fire & Rescue
services.evidence: The City of Hampton's EMS Cost Recovery Program is designed to recover the costs of emergency medical services associated with a patient assessment and/or patient transport to the hospital by ambulance.

51650.page_note: Hampton Division of Fire & Rescue is licensed for ALS. Cardinal Ambulance Service (BLS, Hampton) is also licensed; not yet confirmed from a public source whether it answers 911.

services.name: Suffolk Department of Fire & Rescue
services.evidence: 1 Citywide Shift Commander 2 Battalion Chiefs 2 EMS Supervisors 11 Engine Companies 4 Ladder Companies 2 Heavy Rescue Companies 9 Advanced Life Support Ambulances

51800.page_note: Suffolk Fire & Rescue holds the only ALS ground-ambulance licence in Suffolk.

services.name: Stafford County Fire and Rescue Department
services.evidence: Emergency Medical Service (EMS) transport billing started October 1, 2006 in Stafford County. Stafford County Fire and Rescue Department is committed to providing the finest emergency medic

51179.page_note: Stafford County Fire and Rescue is a county fire department. Incarnate Ambulance (Woodbridge) holds a BLS commercial licence.

services.name: Chesterfield Fire and EMS (CFEMS)
services.evidence: CFEMS operates 21 staffed engine companies, 6 staffed truck companies, and 22 staffed transport units. CFEMS is supported by four volunteer rescue squads operating from seven stations providing 174 EMS providers responding primarily nights and weekends. (PDF p.67) ... The revenue generated through transports by the four volunteer rescue squads is forwarded to the appropriate squad on a quarterly basis. (PDF p.75)

services.name: Bensley-Bermuda Volunteer Rescue Squad
services.area: part of county (RB1 Chester, RB3 South Chesterfield)
services.evidence: The Bensley-Bermuda Volunteer Rescue Squad (BBVRS) ... operates from two stations ... BBVRS units combined to provide 1,886 responses

services.name: Ettrick-Matoaca Volunteer Rescue Squad
services.evidence: The Ettrick-Matoaca Volunteer Rescue Squad (EMVRS) ... operates from a single station (RE1) ... EMVRS units combined to provide 3,771 responses

services.name: Forest View Volunteer Rescue Squad
services.area: part of county (RF3, RF5 Midlothian Tpk)
services.evidence: The Forest View Volunteer Rescue Squad (FVVRS) ... operates from two stations ... FVVRS units combined to provide 6,673 responses

services.name: Manchester Volunteer Rescue Squad
services.evidence: The Manchester Volunteer Rescue Squad (MVRS) ... operates out of two stations ... The MVRS units combined to provide 2,377 responses

51041.page_note: Each volunteer rescue squad owns and operates its apparatus and is a separate EMS agency within the Chesterfield Fire and EMS system (county standards-of-cover document). HCA Virginia Medical Transport is a hospital interfacility licence.
51041.second_source: OEMS roster (CHESTERFIELD FIRE AND EMS, MANCHESTER VRS, BENSLEY-BERMUDA VRS, FOREST VIEW VRS, ETTRICK-MATOACA VRS)

services.name: Loudoun County Combined Fire and Rescue System
services.evidence: Loudoun County Combined Fire-Rescue System has partnered with EMS-MC

51107.page_note: Loudoun County Combined Fire and Rescue System bills for ambulance transport. The state also licenses the Loudoun County, Ashburn, Arcola, Lovettsville, Round Hill, Purcellville, Sterling, Blue Ridge and Hamilton volunteer companies; not yet confirmed from a county page which ones transport.

services.name: Henrico County Division of Fire
services.evidence: Utilizing the above staff and equipment we provide the following services: Urban and Rural fire services and response Emergency Medical Advanced life support services and transport

51087.page_note: Confirmed: Henrico County Division of Fire transports. Tuckahoe and Lakeside Volunteer Rescue Squads are also licensed; their role is not yet confirmed from a public source.

services.name: Richmond Ambulance Authority
services.evidence: On March 20, 1991, the Virginia General Assembly passed the Richmond Ambulance Authority Act and on September 23, 1991, the City of Richmond granted the franchise to Richmond Ambulance Authority (RAA) to provide EMS to the City.

services.name: Richmond Fire & Emergency Services
services.evidence: Non Transport First Response - BLS (OEMS roster)

51760.page_note: Confirmed: Richmond Ambulance Authority holds the franchise. American Medical Response Mid-Atlantic, Richmond Volunteer Rescue Squad and MetroHealth EMS are also licensed at Richmond addresses; their role is not yet confirmed from a public source.

services.name: Spotsylvania County Fire, Rescue & Emergency Management
services.evidence: On April 5, 2005, the Spotsylvania County Board of Supervisors adopted Section 9-39 of the Spotsylvania County Code which will allow the county to charge for ambulance service effective October 1, 2005.

51177.page_note: Confirmed: Spotsylvania County Fire, Rescue & Emergency Management. Spotsylvania Volunteer Rescue Squad is also licensed; not yet confirmed from a public source how the two divide calls.

services.name: Roanoke Fire-EMS
services.evidence: Fire-Emergency Medical Services Fees Department Fire-EMS ... Fee for ground transportation by ambulance vehicle for providing a level of Basic Life Support medical care

51770.page_note: Roanoke Fire-EMS charges ambulance transport fees and serves the city. Roanoke Emergency Medical Services Inc. is also licensed with a Roanoke address; not yet confirmed what it does.

services.name: Roanoke County Fire & Rescue Department
services.area: Roanoke County excl. Roanoke and Salem
services.evidence: Ambulance transport billing and related requests are handled by our third-party billing partner, Medusind .

51161.page_note: Roanoke County Fire & Rescue is a combination system using career and volunteer personnel. Cave Spring First Aid & Rescue Squad and Vinton First Aid Crew are also licensed as ground ambulances; not yet confirmed from a public source what role they play.

services.name: James City County Fire Department
services.evidence: All James City County Firefighters are cross-trained in emergency medical services, and every ambulance is staffed around the clock with at least one advanced life support provider. ... Medicaid, Medicare and the majority of private insurance policies include the cost of ambulance transport.

51095.page_note: James City County Fire Department staffs the county ambulances and bills for ambulance transport. The City of Williamsburg runs its own ambulances inside the city.

services.name: York County Fire Department
services.evidence: the York County Fire Department strives to provide the best fire and emergency medical services possible to our citizens, businesses, and visitors. ... Our EMS transport cost recovery program, or what is commonly known as EMS transport fee, is structured with concern for the medical and financial health of our County residents and visitors.

51199.page_note: York County Fire Department provides 911 ambulance transport and bills for it county-wide.

services.name: Charlottesville Fire Department
services.evidence: Both CARS and Charlottesville Fire Department staffed ambulances will bill for service as part of the Emergency Medical Services ( EMS ) Cost Recovery Program.

services.name: Charlottesville-Albemarle Rescue Squad (CARS)
services.evidence: Will the Charlottesville-Albemarle Rescue Squad (CARS) bill for service in the City? Yes.

51540.page_note: Charlottesville Fire Department and the Charlottesville-Albemarle Rescue Squad both run 911 ambulances in the city and bill for transport there. Albemarle County Fire Rescue describes its ambulance service as covering Albemarle County. UVA Health's medical transport network is a hospital transport service.

services.name: Winchester Fire and Rescue Department
services.evidence: The Winchester Fire and Rescue (WFRD) Revenue Recovery Program is based on concern for the medical and financial health of city residents. ... If you need to provide insurance information regarding your transport or have specific questions about your bill, please contact the City’s billing agency, Digitech

51840.page_note: Confirmed: Winchester Fire and Rescue answers 911 calls in the city. Not yet confirmed from a public source: whether Valley Health's Valley Medical Transport ambulances also carry emergency patients in Winchester.

services.name: King George County Department of Fire, Rescue and Emergency Services
services.evidence: King George County began charging fees for emergency medical transports in 2007, but individuals will not see any disruptions in the emergency response services provided by rescue personnel and no one will ever be denied necessary medical transport service due to their inability to pay or a lack of insurance.

51099.page_note: King George County Fire, Rescue and Emergency Services provides 911 ambulance transport county-wide.

services.name: Colonial Heights Fire and EMS Department
services.evidence: Fare Care is a subscription program that helps cover out-of-pocket costs for emergency ambulance transport under the city's Cost Recovery Program.

51570.page_note: The Colonial Heights Fire and EMS Department provides 911 ambulance transport in the city.

services.name: Manassas Park Fire and Rescue Department
services.evidence: The Department is a full- service fire and emergency medical service (EMS) agency delivering suppression services, EMS as an advanced life support transport agency
services.vintage: 2022 Standards of Cover; current apparatus page lists two medic units

51685.page_note: Manassas Park Fire and Rescue is the city's ambulance transport agency, with automatic aid from Prince William County and the City of Manassas.

services.name: Poquoson Fire & Rescue (with Poquoson Volunteer Rescue Squad)
services.ownership: mixed: city fire department with volunteer rescue squad
services.evidence: Each of our ambulances is staffed to the Advanced Life Support standards established by the State of Virginia.

51735.page_note: Poquoson Fire & Rescue runs the city ambulances; the Poquoson Volunteer Rescue Squad also keeps an ambulance in the city system.

services.name: Williamsburg Fire Department
services.evidence: The department currently has a fleet of four ambulances containing sophisticated state-of-the-art life-saving equipment designed specifically for advanced life support. Two of the ambulances are always operational, with the other two functioning as reserve units. In the event that both ambulances are on a call, the next closest ambulance responds as part of our mutual aid agreement with James City County and York County Fire Departments.

51830.page_note: Williamsburg Fire Department runs the city ambulances, backed by James City County and York County under mutual aid.

services.name: Goochland County Department of Fire-Rescue and Emergency Services
services.ownership: mixed: county department with volunteer companies
services.evidence: When did Goochland County implement EMS billing? Goochland County began billing for EMS transports on January 1, 2013.

51075.page_note: Goochland County Department of Fire-Rescue and Emergency Services runs the county ambulances and bills for 911 transport.

51740.page_note: Portsmouth Fire, Rescue & Emergency Services transports 911 patients in the city. Not yet confirmed: the role of Tidewater Medical Transport, a private ambulance company licensed in Portsmouth.

51145.page_note: Powhatan County Fire & Rescue, with the Powhatan Volunteer Rescue Squad, provides emergency medical services. Not yet confirmed: a page saying which units carry patients, and the role of the contracted EMS staff.

51127.page_note: New Kent Fire-Rescue publishes the notice for its ambulance transport. Not yet confirmed: a page that states it carries all 911 patients in the county.

51065.page_note: Fluvanna County bills for emergency ambulance transport. The county lists the Office of Emergency Services, the Lake Monticello Rescue Squad and the Fluvanna Volunteer Rescue Squad; which of them carry patients is not yet confirmed.

51750.page_note: The Radford Emergency Medical Services Commission was created by contract with Carilion Patient Transportation Services, and the city fire department holds an ambulance licence. Not yet confirmed: which of them carries 911 patients today.

services.name: Salem Fire-EMS
services.evidence: The Salem Fire and EMS are called upon for emergency medical services more than 4,000 times a year and transports over 3,000 of these patients to three local hospitals.

services.name: Salem Fire-EMS
services.evidence: Fire & Rescue Fee for Service 46210 EMS Revenue Recovery

services.name: Salem Rescue Squad
services.area: City of Salem (all-volunteer squad, listed as a city department)
services.evidence: Our rescue squad currently operates four ALS-equipped ambulances

51775.page_note: Salem Fire-EMS runs three advanced life support ambulances around the clock and bills for transports; the all-volunteer Salem Rescue Squad also runs four ambulances in the city.

51079.page_note: The three volunteer fire companies are first responders. Greene County EMS is the only licensed ambulance service in the county; a page stating that it carries 911 patients is not yet confirmed.

services.name: Caroline County Department of Fire and Rescue
services.evidence: The Department provides EMS transports to approximately 2,850 patients a year to hospitals in both the Fredericksburg and Richmond regions.
services.vintage: no date on page (live 2026-10-22); county agency, no sign of change

51033.page_note: Caroline County Fire and Rescue carries 911 patients across the county; it is the only ground ambulance licence based in the county.

services.name: Botetourt County Fire & EMS
services.area: whole county (career ALS ambulances with volunteer fire and rescue companies under one county system)
services.evidence: In addition to various volunteer fire and EMS resources, the department staffs 5 ALS ambulances and a shift supervisor 24/7.
services.vintage: 2025+ (page names Read Mountain station, county-run after the Nov 2024 dissolution of Read Mountain FD)

51023.page_note: Botetourt County Fire & EMS runs the county's ambulances, working with the volunteer fire and rescue companies in its stations; it holds the only ground ambulance licence in the county.

services.name: Martinsville Fire & EMS
services.evidence: Fire suppression, advanced life support EMS transport, vehicle rescue, technical rescue

51690.page_note: Martinsville Fire & EMS covers the city with two advanced life support ambulances and provides EMS transport.

51197.page_note: Wythe County Emergency Services answers 911 medical calls and transports countywide, and Wytheville Fire & Rescue transports patients in the town. The county works with volunteer rescue squads that are not named, and the role of a private ambulance company based in Wytheville is not yet confirmed.

51590.page_note: Danville Fire Department first-responds without transporting; the city says patients are carried by the city's ambulance agencies. Danville Life Saving Crew runs ambulances in the city, but a page naming every agency that carries 911 patients in Danville is not yet confirmed.

51520.page_note: Bristol Virginia Fire Department transports patients downtown and elsewhere in the city when needed. Bristol Life Saving Crew, licensed in the city, warned in May 2025 that it might close; its current role is not yet confirmed.

services.name: City of Manassas Fire and Rescue Department
services.evidence: Our EMS Transport Rates increased as of July 1, 2025.

services.name: City of Manassas Fire and Rescue Department
services.evidence: I was recently transported by the City of Manassas to the hospital; will I get a bill? Yes, you will receive a bill if you are transported to the hospital.

services.name: Greater Manassas Volunteer Rescue Squad
services.area: City of Manassas, as part of the city fire and rescue system
services.evidence: The GMVRS then became an integral part of the City of Manassas Fire and Rescue System

51683.page_note: The City of Manassas Fire and Rescue Department, together with the Greater Manassas Volunteer Rescue Squad and the Manassas Volunteer Fire Company, staffs the city ambulances and bills for transports. The city's 2025 annual report also counts 2,088 mutual-aid responses into the city from Prince William County and 559 from Manassas Park, and no page says which parts of the city those services cover, so the list may be incomplete.

services.name: Westmoreland County Department of Emergency Services (EMS Division)
services.area: whole county (stations Colonial Beach, Oak Grove, Montross, Coles Point)
services.evidence: Westmoreland County Emergency Medical Services provides emergency medical care to all residents and visitors, regardless of their ability to pay. To help recover the cost of providing these services, the County utilizes a third-party billing service for ambulance transports.

51193.page_note: Westmoreland County Emergency Services runs the county's ambulances from four stations (Colonial Beach, Oak Grove, Montross and Coles Point) and bills for ambulance transports. It is the only ambulance service licensed by the state with a Westmoreland address; the volunteer fire companies in the county are first-response only.

services.name: Richmond County Department of Emergency Services (EMS Division)
services.evidence: The Richmond County Board of Supervisors has approved a scale of income guidelines for those individuals who lack insurance coverage and are interested in applying for an exemption for fees billed for ambulance transports.

51159.page_note: Richmond County Emergency Services provides 24-hour basic and advanced life support emergency medical service to residents and visitors and bills for ambulance transports. It is the only state-licensed ambulance service with a Richmond County address.

services.name: King and Queen County Emergency Services
services.evidence: King and Queen County Emergency Services is responsible for the provision of Emergency Medical Services to King and Queen County as the county’s licensed EMS agency by the Virginia Department of Health.

51097.page_note: King and Queen County Emergency Services is the county's licensed EMS agency; the former volunteer rescue squads now operate under its license, with all emergency response run by the county as one team since November 1, 2024.
51097.second_source: https://kingandqueenco.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Hardship-waiver-form.pdf (county EMS billing form: 'NEW HARDSHIP APPLICATION MUST BE SUBMITTED FOR EACH EMS TRANSPORT')

services.name: Madison County Emergency Medical Services
services.evidence: If we transport you to the hospital, our billing vendor Ambulance Medical Billing (AMB) will send a bill to your insurance company.

51113.page_note: Madison County EMS staffs two advanced life support ambulances around the clock and bills for hospital transports. It is the only state-licensed ambulance service with a Madison County address (the Culpeper, Orange and Greene County services that share some ZIP codes are based in those counties). Not yet confirmed: whether the Sperryville Volunteer Rescue Squad from Rappahannock County, whose first-due area starts at Nethers near Old Rag, carries patients in that corner of Madison County.

services.name: Pulaski County Public Safety (EMS)
services.evidence: In 2025, Pulaski County received more than 6,000 EMS calls. According to Pulaski County Public Safety, only 122 of those led to emergent transportation to a hospital.

51155.page_note: Pulaski County Public Safety runs the county's EMS and transports patients to the hospital (WDBJ, August 2026). It is the only state-licensed ambulance service based in the county; Radford's city service is licensed in Radford. Not yet confirmed from a county page: that Pulaski County Public Safety carries all 911 patients across the whole county, including the towns of Pulaski and Dublin and the Fairlawn area, and what the county's separate ambulance-service budget line pays for.
51155.second_source: state OEMS licence 00856, Pulaski County Public Safety, 143 Third St NW, Pulaski (valid to 2027-02-28)

services.name: Hopewell Fire & EMS
services.evidence: The Ride Saver Program offers City of Hopewell residents unlimited medically necessary transports for one year

services.name: Hopewell Fire & EMS
services.evidence: Both stations house an advanced life support (ALS) engine and ALS medic
services.vintage: 2023 (Operations page, last changed 2023-11; billing guide 2026 agrees)
